recipe.build:
mkdir -p ${ANDROID_HOME}/platforms/android-36
wget https://github.com/Reginer/aosp-android-jar/raw/refs/heads/main/android-36/android.jar -qO "${ANDROID_HOME}"/platforms/android-36/android.jar
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-size 16 --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

wget https://github.com/Reginer/aosp-android-jar/raw/refs/heads/main/android-36/android.jar -qO "${ANDROID_HOME}"/platforms/android-36/android.jar
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-size 16 --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
